channel.title: Flog It!
channel.desc: Paul Martin is joined by experts Charlie Ross and Tracy Martin at Oxford University's beautiful Sheldonian Theatre. Some interesting pieces come up including a stylish Rolex watch and an unwanted inkwell. Paul hears the story behind a book that originally took 70 years to complete - the Oxford English Dictionary. All the items in the show are sent to a packed saleroom in Watlington, Oxfordshire.
